response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.circuitId AS circuitId, ci.country AS country, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09' GROUP BY ci.circuitId, ci.country) SELECT circuitId, country, race_count, race_count * 1.0 / AVG(race_count) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS ratio FROM c ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
